preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1, as the input describes a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertices in the edges must be within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n numbers, one for each k from 1 to n.
All output numbers must be non-negative integers.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i]) <= n // (i + 1) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output number must not exceed the maximum possible number of paths for the corresponding k.
